verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never mentions connecting Gmail or Outlook, two-way email sync, or automatic email logging to records. "Real-time contact syncing" on the pricing page covers contacts, not emails, and "full history of every interaction" is too vague to credit for this story. A CRM could plausibly ship this capability, so the axis applies and the absence of evidence yields none.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can connect Gmail or Outlook so emails sync two-way and log automatically to the right records
